enriched.summary: A aula aborda o uso do Simple Past e Past Continuous para descrever ações no passado, incluindo situações em contextos profissionais. Também foca em verbos irregulares, vocabulário relacionado ao ambiente de trabalho e global warming, além de pronúncia de palavras específicas.

vocabulary.definition: An increase in the Earth's average temperature due to greenhouse gases.
examples: Global warming is a major environmental concern.
Scientists are studying ways to combat global warming.

vocabulary.definition: To make a sound, as in a bell or phone.
examples: The fire alarm rang loudly during the meeting.
She rang the doorbell before entering.

vocabulary.definition: To produce musical sounds with the voice.
examples: She sang beautifully at the concert.
He sings every morning while showering.

vocabulary.definition: To move through water by moving your arms and legs.
examples: He swam across the lake.
They love swimming during summer.

vocabulary.definition: To acquire something by paying for it.
examples: She bought a new dress yesterday.
He buys groceries every weekend.
He caught the ball during the game.
She catches the train every morning.

vocabulary.definition: To engage in a battle or struggle.
examples: They fought bravely in the war.
He fights for his rights every day.

vocabulary.definition: To become stuck or cause something to stop working.
examples: The machine jammed while photocopying the documents.
The door jammed and wouldn't open.

vocabulary.definition: Past tense of 'stop', meaning to cease movement or activity.
examples: The music stopped abruptly during the party.
The car stopped at the red light.

vocabulary.definition: Refers to a place or location.
examples: Where are you going?
This is where I grew up.

vocabulary.definition: To have clothing or accessories on your body.
examples: She wears glasses.
He is wearing a suit today.

grammar.explanation: The Simple Past is used to describe completed actions in the past, while the Past Continuous is used for actions that were ongoing at a specific moment in the past.
examples: The sun was shining brightly when we arrived at the beach.
Something went wrong while the scientist was conducting the experiment.
Everyone was dancing at the party when the music stopped abruptly.
commonMistakes: Using 'was' with plural subjects (e.g., 'They was dancing').
Confusing Simple Past with Present Perfect ('I have danced yesterday').

practiceQuestions.question: Complete with the correct tense: The marketing team / brainstorm / new ideas / when / the fire alarm / ring.
practiceQuestions.answer: The marketing team was brainstorming new ideas when the fire alarm rang.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The first action is ongoing (Past Continuous), and the second action interrupts it (Simple Past).

culturalNotes: Using precise verb tenses is essential for clear communication in professional settings.
studyTips: Practice verb conjugations daily to master irregular forms.
Use real-life scenarios to create sentences in past tenses.
originalExamples: The sun was shining brightly when we arrived at the beach. (O sol estava brilhando intensamente quando chegamos à praia.)
Something went wrong while the scientist was conducting the experiment. (Algo deu errado enquanto o cientista estava conduzindo o experimento.)
Everyone was dancing at the party when the music stopped abruptly. (Todos estavam dançando na festa quando a música parou abruptamente.)

The project manager entered the room while the developers were debating the software architecture. (O gerente de projeto entrou na sala enquanto os desenvolvedores estavam debatendo a arquitetura do software.)
The marketing team was brainstorming new ideas when the fire alarm rang. (A equipe de marketing estava fazendo brainstorming de novas ideias quando o alarme de incêndio tocou.)
While the CEO was delivering her speech, the microphone stopped working. (Enquanto a CEO estava fazendo seu discurso, o microfone parou de funcionar.)
We were discussing the budget when the client asked for a discount. (Estávamos discutindo o orçamento quando o cliente pediu um desconto.)
The Wi-Fi disconnected while I was giving a virtual presentation. (O Wi-Fi desconectou enquanto eu estava fazendo uma apresentação virtual.)
The HR manager was reviewing résumés when her computer crashed. (A gerente de RH estava revisando currículos quando seu computador travou.)
While the legal team was drafting the contract, they found a major error. (Enquanto a equipe jurídica estava redigindo o contrato, eles encontraram um grande erro.)
The delivery arrived while the warehouse staff was/were taking their lunch break. (A entrega chegou enquanto a equipe do armazém estava fazendo sua pausa para o almoço.)
Sarah was preparing the monthly report when she noticed a missing invoice. (Sarah estava preparando o relatório mensal quando notou uma fatura faltando.)
They were negotiating the merger when the news leaked to the press. (Eles estavam negociando a fusão quando as notícias vazaram para a imprensa.)
The lights were flickering while we were holding the board meeting. (As luzes estavam piscando enquanto estávamos realizando a reunião do conselho.)
While the intern was photocopying the documents, the machine jammed. (Enquanto o estagiário estava fotocopiando os documentos, a máquina emperrou.)
I was checking my emails when I received the promotion offer. (Eu estava verificando meus e-mails quando recebi a oferta de promoção.)
